# Owner-runtime closure conclusions

The frozen availability classification remains unchanged: 10 AVAILABLE owners, 6 CUSTODIAN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED owners, and 9 UNAVAILABLE owners. Availability is descriptive registry state; executable admission is a separate fail-closed decision. An AVAILABLE owner is executable only after its approved owner contract is materialized into the content-addressed runtime registry and supplies a complete owner-derived budget, typed parameter/root schema, reconciler, semantic terminal verifier, and any command-specific approval or parent-delegation receipt.

All ten AVAILABLE owners now have finite, authority-approved supplied contracts. These records resolve the prior research evidence-acquisition blockers without claiming that the runtime implements them. Current code still accepts caller-injected unit_budgets, marks every resumed STARTED effect INDETERMINATE, terminalizes EXECUTED effects from return code zero without owner-semantic validation or an owner_terminal event, directly adapts mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry, and validates parameters through hardcoded tables without consuming the materialized owner schema or resolving paths through trusted roots.

Budget conclusions by owner: local-workflow-orch-image, mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry, claude-auth-token-refresh, and discovery-bootstrap each own 28,800,000ms complete units. discovery-promotion-lifecycle owns 28,800,000ms for status/correction commands and 57,600,000ms for drive. commit-push-main owns mode-specific totals from 28,800,000ms through 50,400,000ms. discovery-candidate-reconciliation owns 28,800,000ms audit/validate units and exact manifest-derived execute, rolling, and drive formulas. convergence-checkpoint-run owns 28,800,000ms plus the selected typed child's complete UnitBudget. convergence-state-review-cycle owns 28,800,000ms for dry-run and (M + 9) * 3,600,000ms for apply. greenfield-full-drive owns progressive atomic/frontier reservations with a 3,600,000ms atomic cap, at most 20 features, 5 validation rounds, 4 distinct fatal defects per round, and 20 validation fix chains. Callers supply none of these values.

Each approved proposal names effect identity, prepared observables, ALREADY_APPLIED/NOT_APPLIED/INDETERMINATE reconciliation boundaries, and command-specific semantic terminal rules. These are planner-ready implementation contracts, not current-runtime proof. Terminal success always requires semantic evidence plus exactly one durable owner terminal event; exit zero alone remains insufficient.

mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry is the only child-only AVAILABLE owner. Its allowed parents are exactly mawf-playbook-full-test and mawf-playbook-speed-test. Valid proof is an atomic child_delegation_recorded event bound to an active STARTED parent in the same journal by exact task_id, run_id, branch_ref, and worktree_id; it also binds parent/child effect and intent identities, blocker and same-path verification evidence, mode, and single-use consumption. Gate policy is derived from the allowed parent and is not an additional caller-supplied proof. Both parents retain their frozen CUSTODIAN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED availability, so an AVAILABLE child still fails executable admission when no executable active parent exists.

All five public v8 material-gap IDs remain present as research conclusions and are now planner-owned implementation gaps rather than research blockers: MG-O1-OWNER-BUDGET-EVIDENCE-ABSENT is closed as an acquisition gap but open in runtime materialization/admission; MG-O2-OWNER-RECONCILERS-ABSENT is open in runtime implementation; MG-O3-SEMANTIC-TERMINAL-VERIFICATION-ABSENT is open in runtime implementation; MG-O4-ACTIVE-PARENT-CONTEXT-ABSENT is open in typed dispatch/journal implementation with its exact proof now grounded; and MG-O5-SCHEMA-ROOT-BINDING-ABSENT is open in schema materialization, trusted-root resolution, and pre-argv validation. No additional custodian decision or research-stage acquisition is required for these five defects.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Frozen scope is restricted to the five owner-runtime defects and two authoritative roots, with no availability relabeling or implementation during research.
Exactly ten requirements and ten planner obligations cover current and future budget, reconciliation, terminal, parent, and parameter/root behavior.
Registry enforces the exact frozen 10 AVAILABLE, 6 CUSTODIAN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, and 9 UNAVAILABLE owner membership and cardinality.
evidence_index.limitations: Does not materialize the approved v9 executable contracts.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Current content-addressed registry artifact predates the ten approved proposal contracts.
evidence_index.limitations: Existing fields are not the approved v9 runtime contracts.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Controller accepts caller-provided unit_budgets and lacks complete-contract and parent-delegation admission.
STARTED always becomes INDETERMINATE; exit zero terminalizes without owner semantic verification or owner_terminal event.
Hardcoded adapter tables pass tagged paths through, directly adapt blocker reentry, and expose no implemented owner reconciler.
Tests expect STARTED to become INDETERMINATE and unstructured zero-exit output to terminalize.
Tests inject UnitBudget after controller construction and test capacity rather than owner-authoritative completeness.
Kamen approved the 3,600,000ms atomic cap and all ten budget/root/schema/reconciliation/terminal surfaces without granting execution authority.
evidence_index.limitations: Approval is not implementation or live verification.

research_value.rule: load selected owner reconciler for STARTED, observe without reissuing, persist identity-bound evidence, terminalize only when completion is proved, and execute only after NOT_APPLIED

research_value.exit_zero: necessary where applicable but never sufficient

owner_terminal_rules.discovery-promotion-lifecycle: registered sequence, registry, bundle, same-path verification and closed run agree

owner_terminal_rules.discovery-candidate-reconciliation: every candidate proof, stable re-audit, canonical index and provenance
owner_terminal_rules.convergence-checkpoint-run: matching baseline/guard receipts and exact child semantic terminal
owner_terminal_rules.convergence-state-review-cycle: cycle_status APPLIED and convergence_status equals expected

research_value.exactly_once: one matching durable owner_terminal and terminal artifact; identical replay returns proof and conflict fails

research_value.approved_parent_proof: atomic child_delegation_recorded bound to active STARTED parent and child in exact same-journal task_id, run_id, branch_ref, worktree_id; gate policy derives from parent

research_value.rejection_boundary: before budget reservation, argv construction, or operator call
research_value.availability_admission_separation: child remains AVAILABLE but not executable without executable active allowed parent and valid event
research_value.derived_policy: gate_policy and chain_mode derive from parent
